environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running the legacy monolith directly on the host OS. Ubuntu 20.04 with Postfix MTA on localhost:25. Application runs as www-data user with standard filesystem permissions. /var/spool/mailqueue is writable. No email filtering or header validation at the MTA level. Security group allows outbound SMTP (port 25) to the internet.

config.mta: Postfix on localhost:25 with default relay config
